title: Which soft soil sound belongs to planting?
question: Planting is silent today for the player and every other actor. The sound direction calls for a soft, low pat-pat, as if soil is tucked over a seed; harvest already owns the reward sound. Here are two short CC0 planting recordings, cut to the length of one action and level-matched for comparison. Please listen to both and choose the one that reads as covering a seed, or say neither does. This card only chooses the source; nothing is wired into the game yet.
why_now: Planting is the most repeated action without a sound. Daniel asked to hear free recordings with a recommendation before anyone spends an afternoon recording new game sounds.

options.label: wobesound's planting beats (Recommended)
options.detail: The first 1.5 seconds of “Planting Sounds.wav” have two distinct beats with a pause between them, matching the requested pat-pat timing. This is a provisional recommendation because the recording was made for planting and has two beats; your listening decides whether it actually sounds like soil. Freesound #488393 by wobesound, CC0 1.0: https://freesound.org/people/wobesound/sounds/488393/

options.label: wyronroberth's planting effect
options.detail: A complete 1.24-second planting effect whose volume changes more smoothly than the first recording. It may sound like a single placement rather than two pats; the recording is here so you can judge that directly. Freesound #516249 by wyronroberth, CC0 1.0: https://freesound.org/people/wyronroberth/sounds/516249/

options.label: Neither reads as soil closing
options.detail: Say what is wrong with the recordings. Dmitri will search for another free sound; if none works, planting will be added to the next session that records several game sounds together.
